CommunityApplications.Profile: Apps maintained for the labs group on gitlab.simplythinking.ca. Currently offers botdarr, a chat bot for searching, adding, and monitoring Radarr, Sonarr, and Lidarr content from Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, or Mattermost. Built from https://gitlab.simplythinking.ca/labs/botdarr (a mirror of https://github.com/shayaantx/botdarr with local additions) and published to Docker Hub as rootd00d/botdarr.
